Hi Samantha,

Hope you're doing well — as we discussed in the renewal thread, we'd like to schedule a single consolidated session that covers the renewal commercial items plus a compact roadmap demo tailored to Cedar Health's integration priorities. Goal: align product roadmap items, confirm procurement path, and leave with a clear mutual action plan (SOW next steps + sequencing).

Proposed 60-minute windows (ET):
- Tue May 26 — 10:00–11:00
- Wed May 27 — 14:00–15:00

If neither works, please share 2–3 windows that suit your core stakeholders. Helpful prep items for us on your side: attendee list (technical lead + procurement rep) and any agenda items you want us to prioritize (e.g., on-prem private deployment, latency SLOs, audit log retention).

Attached: QBR-agenda-v2.pdf (draft agenda).

High-level agenda we propose:
- 0–10m: introductions & renewal objectives
- 10–30m: roadmap demo (integration flow + performance profile)
- 30–45m: procurement / SOW sequencing and pricing levers
- 45–60m: next steps & open questions

If you prefer, Marissa will run the ops portion (dry-run + recording) and Ben can lead the procurement conversation.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Markus Klein
